commit 4cba444ce9b3e5a4ebed7da839440be585d71c5c
Author:     John Bieling <john@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Fri May 23 22:01:26 2025 +0000
Commit:     John Bieling <john@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Fri May 23 22:01:26 2025 +0000

    Bug 1845108 - Add Thunderbird override for appstrings.properties. r=freaktechnik,tobyp
    
    We are currently using the "default" appstrings from
    
    https://searchfox.org/mozilla-central/source/dom/locales/en-US/chrome/appstrings.properties#23
    
    Firefox however uses a custom override at
    
    https://searchfox.org/mozilla-central/source/browser/locales/en-US/chrome/overrides/appstrings.properties#24
    
    The default strings are not a perfect fit for us as seen by the reported
    issue. This is fixed by also using a custom override for the appstrings,
    which is what this patch is doing.
    
    This is a one-time chance to adapt these strings for Thunderbird.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D250010

diff --git a/mail/base/jar.mn b/mail/base/jar.mn
index a0673cf6c1d..6e0ce55d2e9 100644
--- a/mail/base/jar.mn
+++ b/mail/base/jar.mn
@@ -134,6 +134,7 @@ messenger.jar:
 
 *   content/messenger/buildconfig.html              (content/buildconfig.html)
 % override chrome://global/content/buildconfig.html chrome://messenger/content/buildconfig.html
+% override chrome://global/locale/appstrings.properties chrome://messenger/locale/appstrings.properties
 
 comm.jar:
 % content communicator %content/communicator/
